summary: MineralRite Corp filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026 to provide a first-quarter business update via press release. The update covers renewal of its Skull Valley mineral lease, field sampling by its Qualified Person, environmental credit opportunities, consultant network expansion, and capital structure initiatives. No specific deal terms, prices, premiums, or board recommendations are mentioned. The filing is a routine operational update under Items 7.01 and 8.01, not a special situation event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
